Räumt die Fläche innerhalb geschlossener: Clears the area inside closed vectors down to the target depth: as rings from inside out, back and forth in a grid or as a continuous spiral. Areas inside the pocket remain as islands.
So tief schneidet der Fräser je Durchgan: How deep the cutter cuts per pass. The target depth is divided into equal passes.
Fräst entlang der gewählten Vektoren bis: Cuts along the selected vectors down to the target depth – outside, inside or exactly on the line. For contours, grooves and edges. Open lines are cut back and forth, depth by depth.
Trennt das Teil aus der Platte heraus: D: Separates the part from the plate: the cutter runs around the outside of the contour and cuts all the way through in several passes. Tabs hold the part in place until everything is done; afterwards they are cut by hand.
Graviert mit einem V-Fräser: Die Tiefe f: Engraves with a V-bit: the depth follows the width of the shape – narrow areas stay shallow, wide ones go deep. This creates sharp edges and corners, ideal for lettering and ornaments.
Bohrt in der Mitte jedes gewählten Kreis: Drills a hole in the center of each selected circle or closed contour down to the target depth. Drilling is done in equal pecks; after each peck the drill retracts fully to clear the chips.

Kiefer, Fichte, Pappel: leicht zu fräsen: Pine, spruce, poplar: easy to cut, the fibres tear out easily at the edges.
2 Schneiden, HSS oder Hartmetall. Aufwär: 2 flutes, HSS or carbide. An upcut spiral clears chips well, a downcut spiral leaves clean top edges.
Eiche, Buche, Ahorn, Nuss: fest und dich: Oak, beech, maple, walnut: firm and dense, needs shallower passes than softwood.
2 Schneiden, Hartmetall. Bei dunklen Bra: 2 flutes, carbide. If you see dark burn marks, feed faster or lower the spindle speed.
Birke, Pappel oder Buche, kreuzweise ver: Birch, poplar or beech glued crosswise: the plies tend to tear out at the edges.
2 Schneiden, Hartmetall. Ein Kompression: 2 flutes, carbide. A compression cutter (downcut on top, upcut below) leaves clean edges on both faces.
Holzfaserplatte: gleichmäßig, fräst sich: Fibreboard: even, cuts cleanly, makes very fine dust.
2 Schneiden, Hartmetall: der Leim in der: 2 flutes, carbide: the glue in the board dulls HSS cutters quickly.
Keine Kühlung, aber unbedingt absaugen:: No cooling, but always extract the dust: it is harmful to breathe.
Plexiglas (PMMA): schmilzt, wenn der Frä: Plexiglass (PMMA): melts when the cutter rubs instead of cutting.
1 Schneide (Einschneider, O-Nut), Hartme: 1 flute (single-flute, O-flute), carbide: a large chip room keeps the chips from melting.
Druckluft, um zu kühlen und die Späne we: Compressed air to cool and blow the chips away.
Polyethylen, POM und ähnliche Kunststoff: Polyethylene, POM and similar plastics: tough, melts when the feed is too slow.
1 Schneide (Einschneider, O-Nut), Hartme: 1 flute (single-flute, O-flute), carbide, sharp: big chips carry the heat away.
PU-Blockmaterial für Modelle und Formen:: PU block for models and moulds: very easy to cut, makes a lot of dust.
2 Schneiden, HSS genügt; für Reliefs ein: 2 flutes, HSS is enough; a ball-nose cutter for reliefs.
No cooling, extract the dust well.
Weiche Legierungen wie 6060 oder 6082. K: Soft alloys such as 6060 or 6082. Shallow passes, the chips must be cleared.
1 oder 2 Schneiden, Hartmetall mit polie: 1 or 2 flutes, carbide with polished flutes (for aluminium).
Isopropanol (Spiritus) aufsprühen oder M: Spray isopropyl alcohol or use minimum-quantity lubrication, blow the chips away.
Spröde Kupferlegierung: bricht kurze Spä: Brittle copper alloy: breaks short chips, tends to pull the cutter into the material.
2 oder 3 Schneiden, Hartmetall mit gerad: 2 or 3 flutes, carbide with a straight (0°) rake so it doesn't pull into the material.
Trocken mit Druckluft oder etwas Schneid: Dry with compressed air or a little cutting oil.
Reines Kupfer ist weich und zäh: es schm: Pure copper is soft and tough: it smears and sticks to the cutter.
2 Schneiden, Hartmetall, scharf und poli: 2 flutes, carbide, sharp and polished (as for aluminium).
Schneidöl oder Isopropanol, Späne wegbla: Cutting oil or isopropyl alcohol, blow the chips away.
